messages:
maria: Velociti sent the RFI back with 3 exceptions: customer HSM for Private, FedRAMP status for Dedicated, and how caching affects token billing. Need a tidy bundle for the AE by EOD Friday.
omar: Copying the customer's lines: 1) Can we use our own HSM in Private? 2) Is any Redwood offering FedRAMP authorized? 3) Explain prefix/KV cache billing impact and per-token vs per-request.
claire: I'll produce capability_matrix.csv and attach an HSM integration diagram. Quick CSV snippet below.
claire: ```
capability,hosted,dedicated,private,notes
SSO,yes,yes,yes,SAML/OIDC across deployments
Customer HSM,no,partial,yes,Hosted: no hardware HSM; Dedicated: cloud KMS integration; Private: supports customer HSM appliances
KV caching,yes,yes,yes,Automatic prefix/KV caching; reduces billed tokens on hits
```
ryan: Pricing placeholders (mark as estimates): 4x A100 commit = $26,000/mo baseline; Dedicated overage = $0.55/1k tokens; Hosted gen = $0.03/1k tokens; expected cache hit ~30% -> ~30% fewer billed tokens for chat-like workloads.
security: Vendor list for KMS/HSM: AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault, Thales Luna, Utimaco. Validated for Private: AWS KMS, Thales Luna.
maria: Draft RFI reply (please edit): "Thanks Velociti 97 attached: capability matrix, completed security questionnaire, HSM diagram, and pricing_estimate.xlsx. Short answers to exceptions: (1) HSM 97 Private/on-prem supports customer HSM appliances and customer-managed cloud KMS; Dedicated supports cloud KMS integrations; hosted multitenant does not host customer HSM hardware. (2) FedRAMP 97 Redwood is not FedRAMP-authorized as of 2026-03-20; we maintain a prioritized compliance roadmap and can discuss partner-assisted hosting for regulated workloads. (3) Caching/pricing 97 see attached pricing_estimate.xlsx; prefix/KV caching reduces billed token volume depending on hit rate (worked example included)."
omar: Offer a 60-min architecture review with infra/SRE to validate HSM approach.
ops-bot: Reminder created: Velociti RFI bundle due 2026-03-26 17:00 PT. Required attachments: capability_matrix.csv, security_questionnaire_filled.pdf, hsm_integration_diagram.png, pricing_estimate.xlsx. Notifying @ae-nina.
ae-nina: I'll review the bundle Thursday afternoon and sign off if everything is complete.
maria: Thanks team 97 target upload Thu 16:30 PT so AE has time to review.
